# GrowthBook & Bla Bla Car Commercial Discussion
Date: 2026-09-01 | Duration: 37.18000030517578m

## Summary
BlaBlaCar is evaluating Growthbook for experimentation across markets with uneven audience weights, where aggregating results can create statistical bias and may require separate market analyses or custom support. The team prioritizes reliable event tracking and rigorous participant identification over advanced analysis because its data team already automates much of the analysis but faces complex queries, manual effort, and error risk. Growthbook, Growthbook, Confidence, and Unleash were compared; Growthbook stood out for maturity, support, customization, event tracking, guardrails, AI capabilities, and multi-armed bandit support, although some features are not currently used. Adrien is coordinating product, design, data, and technical feedback, while James proposed tailored demos, a Slack collaboration channel, and CEO engagement. Pricing remains decisive: BlaBlaCar expects approximately €7,750 annually for 200 seats, prefers experiment-volume pricing, and is considering a contract signed by October 31st with invoicing deferred to 2027. A pricing discussion is scheduled for Friday at 2:30pm, alongside further stakeholder alignment and technical evaluation.

## Keywords
multi-cohort experiments, data reliability, experiment analysis, vendor evaluation, pricing negotiation, product demo

## Action Items

**Adrien LOISON**
Consult data analysts to assess if multi-experiment global analysis is a must-have feature for BlaBlaCar (08:52)
Discuss the multi-experiment analysis feature needs with product managers and leads upon their return to evaluate priority and requirements (08:52)
Coordinate scheduling a product demo session involving product managers, data scientists, and design team members to showcase Growthbook capabilities tailored to BlaBlaCar’s needs (09:48)
Confirm and communicate preferred date/time for the pricing call scheduled on Friday at 2:30 pm to discuss flexible pricing options (31:41)
Provide ongoing feedback regarding pricing negotiations and budget constraints, emphasizing the maximum budget of approximately 7.75K euros (27:19)

**James Shannon**
Investigate Growthbook's current support for global or merged multi-audience experiment analyses and explore possible workarounds or custom solutions (04:13)
Engage Growthbook’s engineering and data science teams to explore building custom features to support BlaBlaCar’s multi-cohort experiment use cases if necessary (07:54)
Arrange a Slack channel connecting BlaBlaCar’s data team with Growthbook’s data science and solutions teams for asynchronous technical support and troubleshooting (21:30)
Prepare and propose an agenda for the upcoming product demo based on feedback from Adrien and BlaBlaCar teams to ensure it addresses their key needs (11:25)
Schedule and conduct a pricing discussion call on Friday at 2:30 pm, bringing ideas for flexible pricing structures and invoice timing options to align with BlaBlaCar’s budget cycle (30:41)
Consider preparing alternative pricing models, including experiment-based billing rather than unlimited seats, to better align with BlaBlaCar's phased adoption and expected experiment volume (33:38)
Coordinate involvement of Growthbook CEO for strategic discussions on scaling from in-house tools to vendor solutions, sharing relevant migration insights with BlaBlaCar (22:12)
